review_notes: I read the whole file. I also checked the imported definitions of `diag2`/`swap2` (KC/UnitaryCoordBlocks.lean) and `subfieldGL_diagU`/`mem_Bst_iff` (CTP/StdSub.lean). I looked for repeated nontrivial reasoning. Two patterns show up. The first is the repeated matrix-entry forms of `diag2`/`swap2`. The second is the `dgVec` pointwise case split under a unit homomorphism. Other repetitions are too short or routine to qualify: the `congrArg (fun u => (u : K₀)) … simpa` unit-to-value extractions, and the primitive-root `eq_pow_of_pow_eq_one` uses in `exists_mem_K₀` and `Bst_inf_Jst_eq`, which have different contexts. I did not compile any replacement, so both are proposals. The first is the stronger of the two.

findings.problem: The explicit matrix forms of `swap2` and `diag2` are re-derived as local `have`s in three theorems. `swap2` is `!![0, 1; -1, 0]` in `swap2_mul_diag2` (h2), `swap2_mul_self` (h2) and `eq_one_of_commute_swap_diag` (s). The `diag2` form `!![(u : F), 0; 0, ((u⁻¹ : Fˣ) : F)]` is re-proved with the same `ext i j; fin_cases i <;> fin_cases j <;> simp [diag2]` block in `swap2_mul_diag2` (h3, h4) and `eq_one_of_commute_swap_diag` (d). `dg3_eq_emb` also restates it as another local `h2`. The defining file `KC/UnitaryCoordBlocks.lean` gives no `coe_diag2` or `coe_swap2` lemmas, so every user re-derives the forms.
findings.proposed_change: State two coercion lemmas once, near the start of the `Emb` section. `coe_swap2 : ((swap2 : GL (Fin 2) F) : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) F) = !![0, 1; -1, 0] := rfl`. `coe_diag2 (u : Fˣ) : ((diag2 u : GL (Fin 2) F) : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) F) = !![(u : F), 0; 0, ((u⁻¹ : Fˣ) : F)]`, proved by the existing `ext i j; fin_cases i <;> fin_cases j <;> simp [diag2]` (it may be closed by `rfl` via `Matrix.diagonal`, as `dg3_eq_emb` does). Optionally add `coe_swap2_inv` for the `!![0, -1; 1, 0]` form used as h1. Then `swap2_mul_diag2` becomes `rw [Units.val_mul, Units.val_mul, coe_swap2_inv, coe_swap2, coe_diag2, coe_diag2]` followed by one entrywise `fin_cases` simp, and h3/h4 vanish. In `swap2_mul_self` and `eq_one_of_commute_swap_diag`, replace `s`, `d` and `h2` by `rw [coe_swap2]`/`rw [coe_diag2]`. The `diag2` form in `dg3_eq_emb` also becomes `rw [coe_emb, coe_diag2]`. The lemmas should be proved in the file that defines `diag2` and `swap2`, so later files can reuse them.
findings.benefit: About six duplicated `have` blocks, including four copies of the same case-split proof, are replaced by two stated-once lemmas. Later theorems about `diag2`/`swap2` then read as short rewrites. A change to the definition of `diag2` or `swap2` needs one proof update instead of several.

findings.problem: Both proofs show the same fact: applying the unit homomorphism `Units.map K₀.subtype.toMonoidHom` commutes with the pointwise definition of `dgVec`. `subfieldGL_dg3` does `unfold dg3; rw [subfieldGL_diagU]; congr 1; funext i; simp only [dgVec]; split_ifs <;> simp`. The second bullet of `dg3_mem_Bst` repeats `unfold dg3; congr 1; funext i; simp only [dgVec]; split_ifs <;> simp`. The same case split on `i = a`, `i = b` is also done for `dg3_eq_emb` and inside `Bst_inf_Jst_eq`. Each time the lemma is rediscovered through `congr 1; funext; split_ifs`.
findings.proposed_change: Add one lemma `dgVec_map {G : Type} [Field G] (φ : Fˣ →* Gˣ) (a b : Fin 3) (u : Fˣ) : dgVec a b (φ u) = fun i => φ (dgVec a b u i)`. Prove it by `funext i; simp only [dgVec]; split_ifs <;> simp [map_inv]`, or `apply_ite`. Use `φ := Units.map K₀.subtype.toMonoidHom` with `F := K₀` on the source side. Then `subfieldGL_dg3` is `unfold dg3; rw [subfieldGL_diagU, dgVec_map]`. The second bullet of `dg3_mem_Bst` is `unfold dg3; rw [dgVec_map]`, with `dgVec a b u₀` supplied as the witness in `mem_Bst_iff`. Both goals have the form `diagU (fun i => Units.map _ (dgVec a b u₀ i)) = …`.
findings.benefit: The pointwise case analysis lives in one named lemma. The two torus-membership proofs shrink to rewrites, and the `dgVec` unfolding no longer leaks into proofs about `Bst`. Any future change to `dgVec` would be fixed in one place.
